description: Defines internal extension methods for numeric and time span types, providing ceiling operations and conversions for use within the Orleans.Streaming.AdoNet namespace.

classes.name: Extensions
classes.description: A static class providing extension methods for double and TimeSpan types, designed for internal use within the Orleans.Streaming.AdoNet namespace.

methods.name: Int32Ceiling
methods.description: Converts the ceiling of a double value to an integer.

methods.name: TotalSecondsCeiling
methods.description: Returns the total seconds of a TimeSpan rounded up to the nearest second as an integer.

methods.name: SecondsCeiling
methods.description: Converts the total seconds of a TimeSpan (rounded up) back to a TimeSpan object.
